content:
anna_sales: Heads-up — AstroHealth RFI landed. They want a 4-week dedicated POC + written RFI answers for KMS/HSM, FedRAMP posture, and a capability matrix for embeddings + chat. Can we align on the ask before I send our pack? I attached customer_rfi_v1.pdf to the thread.
jordan_se: We can support dedicated GPU pools + private KMS. For perf sizing I need their target QPS and typical sequence length. Who's owning perf tests? @maria_ps?
maria_ps: I can take perf. Two requests for AstroHealth: sample dataset (or synthetic load) and target SLO (p99 latency target, e.g. <150ms) + max concurrency. Also confirm model family — quantization path changes numbers (gptj/llama/mistral?).
anna_sales: They want embeddings for semantic search and chat fallback to a smaller model. Pricing Q: do we have a short-term POC rate for 4 weeks + reserved baseline? Need a ballpark to put in the RFI.
jordan_se: Quick draft for POC pricing: timeboxed Dedicated POC option — baseline reserved node pool + usage overage. Example stub: baseline 1x A10 pool ~ $6,000/week, with negotiated enterprise discount for multi-week. Will require finance confirmation but fine to include as provisional.
sam_security: @anna_sales @maria_ps — I'll need to send them the security questionnaire link. They specifically asked for network diagrams, KMS separation, and whether we support HSM-backed keys on Private deployments. Short answer: yes for Private with HSM partner integration, but we must caveat with "subject to legal/compliance signoff".
maria_ps: Uploaded a short capability matrix snippet for the RFI. Paste below so we can iterate:
```
Feature,Hosted,Dedicated,Private
Embeddings,✔️,✔️,✔️
Private KMS,✖️,✔️,✔️
HSM-backed keys,✖️,✔️,✔️ (partner)
FedRAMP Docs,Limited,Limited,By request
SLA,Standard,Premium,Enterprise
Fallback routing,Region-based,Policy-driven,Policy-driven
```
anna_sales: Perfect — I'll attach that. Also they asked for an explicit fallback policy example (what happens when Dedicated capacity is saturated). @jordan_se can we provide a short sample policy for the RFI?
jordan_se: Yes — we have an "auto-fallback" policy template: prefer primary dedicated pool, on saturation: (1) spill to reserved burst nodes, (2) cross-region failover to secondary dedicated pool, (3) degrade to a lower-cost open-source model variant with client-side notification. I'll draft a one-paragraph summary to include.
sam_security: One potential blocker: AstroHealth requires SOC2 Type II and encryption-at-rest attestations. We have SOC2 completed for core controls; Type II for the newest scope is in progress. Compliance says we can provide interim evidence (Type I and control attestations) plus a timeline. Legal needs to sign off on interim acceptance.
maria_ps: Compliance team confirmed they can produce an interim attestation packet and a timeline to the Type II completion. I'll include that note in the RFI answers.
anna_sales: Next steps I propose:
1) I'll send the perf questions to AstroHealth and request sample dataset + target SLOs.
2) Add provisional POC pricing stub (marked "subject to finance sign-off").
3) Attach capability matrix snippet and link to security questionnaire.
4) Include the fallback policy paragraph from @jordan_se and interim compliance notes from @maria_ps.
Can folks review the draft before EOD tomorrow? Reviewers: @jordan_se, @sam_security, @maria_ps.
jordan_se: :thumbsup: I will review by 3pm PT tomorrow.
sam_security: :white_check_mark: I'll draft the KMS/HSM appendix and the security questionnaire answers by EOD.
doc-bot: Document uploaded: rfi_response_draft_v2.pdf — https://files.redwood.internal/rfi/1764444444/rfi_response_draft_v2.pdf
anna_sales: Thanks all. If no objections, I'll send the package COB tomorrow and flag any outstanding items in the cover email.
